WITH batting_player AS (
  SELECT b.*, p.death_country
  FROM batting b
  INNER JOIN player p ON b.player_id = p.player_id
),
grouped_counts AS (
  SELECT death_country, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM batting_player
  GROUP BY death_country
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN death_country IS NOT NULL THEN cnt END) as total
  FROM grouped_counts
),
with_share AS (
  SELECT 
    g.death_country,
    g.cnt,
    CAST(g.cnt AS FLOAT) / t.total as share
  FROM grouped_counts g, total_count t
  WHERE g.death_country IS NOT NULL AND t.total IS NOT NULL
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_shr FROM with_share
),
final_result AS (
  SELECT 
    w.death_country,
    w.cnt,
    w.share,
    w.share - a.avg_shr as diff
  FROM with_share w, avg_share a
  WHERE a.avg_shr IS NOT NULL AND w.share > a.avg_shr
)
SELECT death_country, cnt as count, share, diff as share_minus_avg
FROM final_result
ORDER BY death_country
